learnedRules.name: Strict Index Upward Confluence Filter for CE
learnedRules.condition: NIFTY Spot > NIFTY Day Open AND PCR Drift >= 0.00
learnedRules.description: Blocks stock CE breakouts if NIFTY is below morning Open or printing negative PCR velocity.

learnedRules.name: Bullish PCR Put Writing Veto for PE Buys
learnedRules.description: Vetoes downside PE entries when institutional put writing creates a solid market floor.

learnedRules.name: Late-Day Entry Cutoff & Volume Filter (Rule 4D)
learnedRules.description: Blocks new entries after 2:15 PM unless backed by an institutional volume surge.

tradeForensics.rootCause: Manual or Discretionary Exit: Position was squared off manually prior to structural resolution.
tradeForensics.tacticalMistake: Discretionary early exits risk truncating target runs and eroding statistical expectancy.
tradeForensics.whatCouldHaveBeenDone: Trust the statistical edge; let the algo manage orders strictly to pure spot SL or target.

keyLearnings: Analyzed loss patterns: index drift confluence remains the #1 determinant of single-stock option continuation.
Dynamic SL verification: zero synthetic slippage observed; real spot triggers matched expected risk brackets.
PCR Velocity Drift successfully filtered false counter-trend signals across market sessions.
